name: mcp-obsidian
display_name: MCP-Obsidian - Universal AI Bridge for Obsidian
description: Connect any MCP-compatible AI assistant to your Obsidian vault with safe read/write access
long_description: MCP-Obsidian is a universal AI bridge for Obsidian vaults using the Model Context Protocol (MCP) standard. Connect Claude, ChatGPT, and future AI tools to your knowledge base with safe read/write access while preventing YAML frontmatter corruption. Features include: 13 comprehensive tools (read_note, write_note, delete_note, move_note, list_directory, read_multiple_notes, search_notes, get_frontmatter, update_frontmatter, get_notes_info, get_vault_stats, manage_tags, patch_note), write modes (overwrite/append/prepend), tag management, path security, and token-optimized responses.

tools.name: read_note
tools.description: Read a note from the vault with parsed frontmatter

tools.name: write_note
tools.description: Write a note to the vault with optional frontmatter (supports overwrite/append/prepend modes)

tools.name: patch_note
tools.description: Efficiently update parts of a note by finding and replacing exact string matches

tools.name: list_directory
tools.description: List files and directories in the vault

tools.name: delete_note
tools.description: Delete a note from the vault (requires confirmation for safety)

tools.name: move_note
tools.description: Move or rename a note in the vault

tools.name: search_notes
tools.description: Search for notes by content or frontmatter with configurable limits

tools.name: read_multiple_notes
tools.description: Read multiple notes in a batch (maximum 10 files)

tools.name: get_frontmatter
tools.description: Extract only the frontmatter from a note without reading full content

tools.name: update_frontmatter
tools.description: Update frontmatter of a note without changing content

tools.name: get_notes_info
tools.description: Get metadata for notes without reading full content

tools.name: get_vault_stats
tools.description: Get vault statistics including total notes, folders, size, and recently modified files

tools.name: manage_tags
tools.description: Add, remove, or list tags in a note (manages both frontmatter and inline tags)

vault_path.title: Obsidian Vault Path
vault_path.description: Path to your Obsidian vault directory. The server will have read/write access to .md, .markdown, and .txt files in this directory.
